{{Top}}
[[File:Gun_Runner_by_Kieran_Yanner.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A gun runner showing his wares]]
{{Quote|Trust me, size matters.|Unidentified gun runner|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Gun Runner}}</ref>}}
An '''arms dealer''', '''arms merchant''',<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> or '''weapons dealer''', was one who dealt in the trade of weapons. [[Weazel/Legends|Weazel]] and a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Unidentified Trandoshan arms dealer|associate]] of his worked as arms dealers on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during which time the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Dreddon]] was also active.<ref name="Outlander">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Pablo/Legends|Pablo]] sold arms and armor in his [[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|pawnshop]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TCW: Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> The individual known as [[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]] was a well-known arms dealer during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
